newsitem.title: USA: Plains feedlot cattle market inactive - feedlots.
newsitem.headline: Plains feedlot cattle market inactive - feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains cattle markets near midday Tuesday were inactive, with no sales reported, according to feedlot sources.
Packer bids were light at $70.00 per cwt, but feedlot managers said owners were not going to budge from asking levels of $72.00.
Sales were not expected to occur until at least Thursday when packers were seen returning to the market to replenish live inventories.
Packers were seen ultimately paying the $72.00, which would be unchanged from last week's top price.
